statements.impact_statement: CVE-2026-42151 is in the config API (web/api/v1) returning the Azure OAuth client secret. tidb-operator imports one package of the module, model/relabel (pkg/apis/pingcap/v1alpha1/tidbmonitor_types.go: the RelabelConfig type of TidbMonitor), and links no Prometheus server code. The fixed line (v0.311.3) requires k8s.io 0.35, which breaks the controller-runtime 0.7.2 and apiserver 0.29 the operator is built on. Verified on 2026-11-14 on the x86_64 local gate build: the guard grep over the four built binaries returned 0 matches for those packages. The melange recipe repeats that search on every build output for symbols under prometheus/prometheus/{web,config,storage,promql,tsdb,scrape,rules,notifier} and fails the build if one appears.
